recruiterCard.summary: Built a sports analytics application that engineers match features, trains classification models, and validates season-over-season performance to avoid overfitting.
impactBullets: Engineered features from historical match data and trained classification models using scikit-learn pipelines.
Evaluated season-over-season performance to validate model generalization and reduce overfitting risk.
Combined sports context, feature design, and model evaluation into a cleaner decision workflow.
